summary: Smooth vendor trial credit usage across teams and deferred invoice approval for multi-billing cycles
description: Issue summary: Multiple internal teams received overlapping vendor trial credits (Vendor: LexiBench) and billing for usage crossed month boundaries. Finance has flagged inconsistent invoice naming and missing cost-center tags which prevents automated chargeback. Impact: Potential misallocation of ~$15k in temporary seats across three cost centers for February-March trials; delays in approvals for continued access. Request: (1) consolidate remaining trial credits so teams can draw from a single pool until 2026-03-31, (2) apply deferred invoice approval for any charges generated before consolidated pooling is completed, (3) ensure all invoices include cost-center metadata in the vendor's billing descriptor and in the invoice PDF, and (4) push an Okta attribute mapping update to include "costCenter" on group sync to vendor via SCIM. Background: LexiBench provided per-team promo codes during a sales-led pilot. Some teams (R&D-Infra, Search-Relevance, CS-Ops) used separate codes which created discrete invoice line items. The vendor supports invoice naming and SCIM attribute mapping but requires us to request changes and provide a signed addendum. Desired outcome: Single trial credit pool, automated cost-center propagation for any paid charges, and a documented runbook for future vendor pilots to prevent repeated manual reconciliation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Identify vendor promo codes in procurement portal. 2) Verify usage logs from vendor portal for February and March. 3) Cross-check invoice line items with internal cost-center tags. 4) Observe missing cost-center metadata on vendor PDF invoices and on API invoice payloads.

investigation_notes: Checked vendor usage CSVs: three promo codes used: LX-RED-100, LX-RELV-50, LX-CS-TRIAL. Total remaining credit across codes: $22,400 as of 2026-03-01.
Invoices in accounting system: two invoices generated (2026-02-28, 2026-03-02). Vendor API payload shows no costCenter field. PDF descriptor currently: 'LexiBench Usage' - needs augmentation.

Okta SCIM: current mapping includes group name and email; custom attribute 'costCenter' exists in Okta user profile but not surfaced in group-to-vendor mapping. PR #1289 opened to git repo 'infra/identity-sync' to add attribute to outbound SCIM group payload.

Hypothesis: If vendor applies consolidated credits and we add costCenter to SCIM payload, invoices will include descriptors that allow automated allocation in NetSuite. If vendor cannot alter descriptor, finance will need manual tagging which is high effort.
Linked slack threads: #vendor-lexibench-thread, #finance-billing. Related Confluence runbook draft: /confluence/procurement/vendor-pilot-runbook (pending).
resolution: In progress: Addendum sent to vendor and awaiting signature; Okta SCIM PR merged to staging and vendor sandbox validation scheduled for 2026-03-07. Finance approved deferred invoice hold for charges through 2026-03-15. Follow-ups: Procurement to confirm signed addendum and confirm credit consolidation; Finance to reconcile post-consolidation and update chargeback process; SRE to monitor SCIM sync logs after vendor sandbox validation.
